plain: Every product is dual-licensed and public: copyleft, or a paid grant to ship closed. Compression through your tools runs every pathway we own and keeps the smallest file that still restores. Signing keys, Chamber kernel secrets, and live customer data stay operator-only.
rule: Public source under dual license. Copyleft or a paid grant. Compression through your tools uses every own pathway. Keys, kernel secrets, and AUTH_DIR stay operator-only.

dual.chooser: You pick copyleft or the commercial grant. Both are written.

copyleft_or_commercial.name: Slid Phi Labs public site and clients

never_on_this_surface: gzip, brotli, xz, or bzip2 sold as ours

fill.plain: Zeros demo. All-zero data → 8 bytes, and you get the original back. Free on POST /api/specialist. For real files, buy PCC.
fill.commercial: This demo is free. Everyday files use PCC.

struct_text.plain: pulsar is the free GPLv3 compressor (OSCB 55,745,438). STR1 is our structure transform on the PCC machine. $490/yr (SKU pulsar-exception, unified grant) to embed pulsar in one closed product.
struct_text.commercial: GPLv3 in public for pulsar. Closed-source embed needs a written exception. STR1 rides the PCC year grant.

archive.plain: Lossless compressor through your tools. Metered $0.25/GB of input, first 1 GB/month free; Pro $25/mo (100 GB included, then $0.20/GB). Customer-set monthly spend cap (default $25), alert at 80%. Source is dual-licensed. Official 12-file numbers live on /silesia.
archive.commercial: AGPL in public. Shipped-code grants follow the unified grant schedule. Keys stay operator-only.

general.plain: LBR1, own LZ wrap (LZW1), and LZMA-style LZM1 run on PCC through your tools. Dual license: AGPL-3.0-or-later, or a PCC year seat. LZM1 is a reimplementation, not host xz.
general.commercial: SKU pcc-pro-year. Compression through your tools already uses this pathway.

paq.plain: Own mixers. PCAQ 256 KiB, ZMX1 1 MiB house, NNC1 256 KiB house. Not paq8px. Not cmix. Those stay GPL research opponents.
paq.commercial: SKU pcc-pro-year. Jobs over the mixer caps skip them.

caps.pcc: first 1 GB/month free, then $0.25/GB of input; Pro includes 100 GB/month, then $0.20/GB; customer-set cap (default $25), alert at 80%
caps.suite: first 1 GB/mo free, then $0.25/GB of input; customer-set cap (default $25), alert at 80%
caps.warrant: 3 warrants + 10 receipts/operator/day free, then the Warrant add-on to Rider Solo (included in Team and Fleet)
caps.chamber: automated fair-use rate limits; bulk moves to metered/enterprise
caps.source_licenses: no usage cap; one product, one term
caps.minimums: card charges start at $1; API amounts below $0.50 rejected
caps.abuse: credential sharing, seat resale, metering evasion terminate without refund

enterprise.plain: Volume seats (10+), private deploy, SLA production: priced on request.
enterprise.subject: Enterprise pricing

unified_grant.plain: One schedule for all shipped code: $490/product/year; founding $190 for the first 10 grants; 3+ products $390 each. Written grant, human-fulfilled, one product + one year per grant, renewal at then-current schedule price. Build-named: TNSSRC grants cover 0.1.0 only.

pulsar-exception.plain: Pay $490/year (unified grant) to put pulsar inside one closed-source product for one year. pulsar source stays GPLv3.
pulsar-exception.grants: Written exception to distribute pulsar inside one closed-source product for one year. pulsar source stays GPL-3.0-or-later.

cuni-exception.plain: Pay $490/year (unified grant) to ship CuNi inside one closed product for one year. The public playground stays free.
cuni-exception.grants: Written exception for one closed product using CuNi, one year.

pcc-meter.plain: PCC meter: $0.25/GB of input, first 1 GB/month free. Customer-set monthly spend cap (default $25), alert at 80%. No source.

pcc-pro.plain: PCC Pro through your tools, one month of access, 100 GB included, then $0.20/GB. No source.

pcc-pro-year.plain: PCC Pro through your tools, one year of access, 100 GB/month included, then $0.20/GB. No source.

unified-grant.plain: Unified closed-use grant: $490/product/year; founding $190 for the first 10 grants; 3+ products $390 each. Written grant, human-fulfilled, one product + one year per grant, renewal at then-current schedule price. Build-named: TNSSRC grants cover 0.1.0 only.

lab-pass.plain: One year of Chamber + Rider Solo + PSI Meter 1 seat + Warrant add-on for $495. PCC/compression out.

oss-support.plain: $199 for help with an already-public GPLv3 library.
oss-support.grants: Commercial support for an already-public GPLv3 library. Not an engine grant.

psi-embed-grant.plain: PSI Embed (shipped code): unified grant $490/product/year. Use, modify, deploy psi closed. psi-month/psi-year SKUs retired.

tnssrc-grant.plain: TNSSRC closed grant, one year, TNSSRC 0.1.0 only. Written grant, human-fulfilled. Founding $190 for the first 10 grants; 3+ products $390 each; renewal at then-current schedule price.
